bug_semantics: Backend Controller.php executed form postback via post('_handler') into runAjaxHandler() with no on[A-Z][\w+]* name check, unlike the AJAX X_WINTER_REQUEST_HANDLER path. That let an authenticated backend user invoke arbitrary controller methods (including action-prefixed, protected, and private ones) on any controller that exposed a public action or cleared $requiredPermissions. The Users controller cleared requiredPermissions for myaccount, so any logged-in backend user could reach update_onDelete / update_onRestore / update_onUnsuspendUser / update_onManualPasswordReset. CSRF still required a valid backend session.

Parent d412ea685560a3ce7028346d26fd9a6559eb0827 has no Controller.php. The Users myaccount/mysettings requiredPermissions=null amplifier arrived later in 94a4ccb6abccd025e7e201590999061574ffdeb9 and is not the BIC.
